en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a crowded seaside beach with many swimmers in the water and sunbathers on the sand. In the background there is a long, low modernist beachfront bathing complex with rows of cabins and terraces, backed by a tree‑covered bluff with a promenade. On the right foreground a woman in an old‑fashioned swimsuit stands looking toward the sea. The bottom margin of the card has captions in Cyrillic and German.
